subject: error in estimating genotype error rate

messages.author: c68e2a9412504c7a
messages.subject: error in estimating genotype error rate
parts:
Hi all,

I am following on page 35 of "Genetic map construction with R/qtl" the
commands to estimate the genotyping error rate from my data.

I followed the commands on page 35 to the letter (using my own cross
object of course):

loglik <- err <- c(0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.0075, 0.01, 0.0125, 0.015,
0.0175, 0.02)
for(i in seq(along=err)) {
cat(i, "of", length(err), "\n")
tempmap <- est.map(aa_clean_lg25, error.prob=err[i])
loglik[i] <- sum(sapply(tempmap, attr, "loglik"))
}

However, I get this error message:

Error in sum(sapply(tempmap, attr, "loglik")) :
invalid 'type' (list) of argument
Execution halted

The cross object I am currently trying to estimate the genotyping
error of has had its linkage groups formed and rf estimated, but its
markers haven't been ordered yet. However, I've also tried using a
cross object which has had its markers ordered on all chromosomes and
I got the same error message.

In trying to debug, but as an R newbie I'm hitting a wall. Am I
getting this error message because sum() doesn't take in list
arguments? (it only takes in numeric or complex or logical vectors,
according to the documentation) If so, should I use as.vector() to
convert the value of sapply() from a list into a numeric, complex, or
logical vector?


Thanks so much for any advice!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] error in estimating genotype error rate
parts:
The code assumes that you're working with multiple linkage groups, and so

sum(sapply(tempmap, attr, "loglik"))

is pulling out and then summing the log likelihoods for each linkage group, to give an overall log likelihood.

But even with one linkage group, you'd have to do something like this, though

loglik[i] <- attr(tempmap[[1]], "loglik")

should work.

But I don't really understand the error, as sapply should return a vector rather than a list.

Perhaps you could privately email me the file from

save(aa_clean_lg25, file="lg25.RData")

so I could reproduce and study the problem.

Or you might try adding a print statement in there to see what it's trying to sum:

print(sapply(tempmap, attr, "loglik"))

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] error in estimating genotype error rate
parts:
For the sake of completeness, here's the resolution of the problem...it had to do with chromosomes with a single marker, in which case estmap returns without a log likelihood attribute.
 
Ah, I had a suspicion that might be the problem. It works now. Thanks so much, Karl!

Elisa

On Tue, Jun 5, 2012 at 3:42 PM, Karl Broman wrote:
it must be the chromosomes with one marker.  use subset to drop those chromosomes before you do this analysis.

karl


On Jun 5, 2012, at 7:22 PM, Elisa Zhang wrote:

I tried adding the print statement as you suggested:

for(i in seq(along=err)) {
cat(i, "of", length(err), "\n")

tempmap <- est.map(data2, error.prob=err[i])
print(sapply(tempmap, attr, "loglik"))
}

And I do seem to get a list of log likelihoods for each linkage group, with a value of "NULL" for my singletons, and negative numbers in the hundreds for the other linkage groups. 

Thanks so much--I really appreciate your help in finding the genotyping error of our cross and ultimately building a more accurate linkage map!

Best,

Elisa
